name: One-handed Mace, Club, Morning Star, Warhammer or Flail (S&G)

system.description:
Heavy weapon: 1d6+1, Strength over 80. Club and warhammer are not named in the 1975 rules; they are treated like the mace on this row. 1975 rules values applied by weapon kind (Sec. 721): most weapons 1d6; daggers and light missiles 1d4; mace, flail, morning star, battleaxe, halberd, poleaxe and pike 1d6+1 with Strength over 80.

Swords & Glory price range in Káitars; the referee rolls (usually 1d10) for quality and the real price. The encumbrance cost uses the S&G scale (in hand or worn / hung or packed), not 1975 Káitar weights.
